patches.game: Saint Seiya - Ougon Densetsu Hen - Perfect Edition
patches.notes:
**Saint Seiya: Ougon Densetsu Hen Perfect Edition** is a 2003 WonderSwan Color game by Bandai. It remakes the 1987 Famicom game *Saint Seiya: Ougon Densetsu* and was released only in Japan. Seiya comes back from Greece with the Pegasus Cloth. He fights in the Galaxian Wars and against the Black Saints and the Silver Saints, then climbs the Twelve Temples of the Sanctuary to save Athena. The game mixes side-scrolling exploration with command battles powered by your Cosmo.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play. It must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like): it isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.

**Another translation already exists**

An earlier English translation of this game, made with Codex by Retroviews (v1.0, October 2026), is available on RetroGameTalk: https://retrogametalk.com/threads/saint-seiya-ougon-densetsuhen-perfect-edition-ai-assisted-translation.71478/

This translation was made by mistake: that one was not listed in the Translations section or on The Repo, so it was not found before the work started.

**Differences between the two versions**

The two were compared line by line, and in an emulator with the same inputs.
